name: PeakIDX Real Estate Search & Lead Generation
author: PeakIDX

sections.description:
PeakIDX is a powerful WordPress plugin that integrates real estate listings from the PeakIDX service into your WordPress site. Transform your website into a lead-generating powerhouse with our blazing-fast IDX search, automated lead management, and beautiful, customizable design.

The Ultimate User Experience Upgrade

Your website is your digital storefront. PeakIDX ensures every visitor has a premium, modern experience that builds trust and keeps them coming back.

Key Features:

Blazing-Fast & Beautiful IDX Search

The property search is the front door to your business. PeakIDX delivers a lightning-fast, visually stunning IDX search experience that captivates buyers, with fully customizable layouts for both thumbnails and property detail pages.

Total Design Freedom for Your Brand

Your brand is unique, and your website should be too. The PeakIDX Site Designer gives you complete control over your site’s look and feel—choose themes, customize fonts, and fine-tune every color to perfectly match your brand.

Powerful Real Estate Widgets for Any Page

Instantly add powerful functionality anywhere on your site. Create and embed customized search forms, contact forms, and pre-configured property showcases with an intuitive copy-and-paste editor. Learn more about Real Estate Widgets.

Build Your Automated Growth Engine

Stop letting leads fall through the cracks. PeakIDX provides an integrated suite of tools designed to turn website traffic into closed deals with maximum efficiency.

Your All-in-One Lead Conversion Machine

Our integrated lead management system is your central command center for every inquiry. Effortlessly track, filter, and assign leads from any source—contact forms, CMA requests, or property inquiries. With detailed lead views and private notes, your team has all the context needed to convert a simple click into a client.

Nurture Leads 24/7 with Smart Autoresponders

Build relationships while you sleep. Create powerful, automated email campaigns that trigger based on lead activity, ensuring every new prospect receives immediate, relevant follow-up. From a simple “Thank You” to a multi-touch drip campaign, our autoresponders establish your expertise from the very first interaction.

Win More Listings with Instant, Data-Driven CMAs

Impress sellers and secure more listings with our premium Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) tool. In just a few clicks, generate a comprehensive, beautifully branded PDF report complete with property details, photos, comparable sales, and a location map. This isn’t just a report; it’s a professional tool that showcases your market authority.

Unmatched Flexibility and Power

Whether you need a simple, all-in-one solution or a powerful tool to integrate with your existing setup, PeakIDX is built to fit your exact needs.

Seamless WordPress Integration

Already have a WordPress site you love? Our dedicated plugin integrates all the power of our IDX search, lead routing, and widgets directly into your domain, complete with a high-performance caching option for speed.

Limitless Possibilities with a Developer API

For custom solutions, our robust, JSON-based REST API is your key. Pull search criteria, fetch filtered listing data, and integrate our powerful real estate search engine into any application you can imagine. Visit https://docs.peakidx.com/ for comprehensive API documentation.

Additional Features:

  • Integrations – Connect PeakIDX with your favorite third-party tools and services, such as CRM systems, marketing platforms, and analytics tools
  • Security – Ensure your data is protected with built-in security measures that comply with industry standards
  • Performance Optimization – Benefit from fast load times and a smooth user experience, keeping visitors engaged and reducing bounce rates
  • Mobile-Friendly Design – Ensure your website looks great and functions seamlessly on all devices, from desktops to mobile phones

Display Options:
– Property listings with shortcodes
– Interactive search forms with shortcodes
– Contact forms with shortcodes
– Optional high-performance caching for faster page loads
– Customizable URL prefix for seamless integration with your site’s structure
– Site design options to change the look and feel of PeakIDX while retaining compatibility via the Site design page for your site at https://account.peakidxsites.com

External Service Notice:
This plugin communicates with the PeakIDX service (https://account.peakidxsites.com) via HTTP requests to fetch and display real estate data. Data such as IP addresses, cookies, and form submissions may be sent to the PeakIDX servers.

Privacy Policy

PeakIDX integrates with the PeakIDX service using the subdomain you select for your site at https://account.peakidxsites.com to provide real estate listings and related functionality. The plugin may send the following data to PeakIDX servers using a secure HTTPS connection:
– User IP addresses (via X-Forwarded-For header)
– Browser cookies (for session management)
– Form submissions (e.g., search or contact form data)

This data is used to deliver personalized content and process user requests. By configuring the plugin with a Site URL and API key, you consent to this data being sent to PeakIDX. For more information on how PeakIDX handles your data, please review their Privacy Policy at https://account.peakidxsites.com/privacy-policy/. If you have concerns about data privacy, contact the PeakIDX support team or your site administrator.

Requirements:
– A PeakIDX account and API key from https://account.peakidxsites.com
– PHP 7.4 or higher with cURL enabled
– WordPress 5.7 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Upload the peakidx folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > PeakIDX > Configure in the WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Log in to https://account.peakidxsites.com/, click the gear icon next to your site on the Sites page, and select API Key.
  5. Copy and paste the Site URL and API Key into the plugin’s configuration fields.
  6. (Optional) Set a custom URL prefix (default: real-estate) for your PeakIDX content. Ensure this does not conflict with existing pages or posts.
  7. Save the settings. If you use caching plugins (e.g., WP Super Cache), clear the cache after saving.

Notes:
– Ensure your server has PHP 7.4+ and cURL enabled.
– After activation, flush rewrite rules by visiting Settings > Permalinks and clicking Save.
– If you encounter 404 errors, verify that the URL prefix does not conflict with existing content.
– The plugin may create a peakidx.txt file in the wp-content/uploads/peakidx/ directory for caching purposes. This file is automatically removed when the plugin is uninstalled.
– This plugin has not been tested with WordPress Multisite and is not officially supported on multisite networks.
sections.faq:
What is PeakIDX?

PeakIDX is a best-in-class real estate website platform for integrating property listings, lead management, and IDX search into WordPress sites. An account and API key are required from https://account.peakidxsites.com. Learn more about all our features.

How do I get started?

Sign up for a free trial at https://account.peakidxsites.com/register. You can be up and running in minutes with our easy onboarding process.

How do I enable high-performance caching?

Login to the WordPress admin, click on PeakIDX -> Configure. After connecting your site, this page will display the code to copy and paste into your wp-config.php file at the top.

What happens if the PeakIDX service is unavailable?

If the PeakIDX service is down, the plugin will display an error message for the parts of the site that depend on PeakIDX.

Why am I seeing 404 errors for PeakIDX pages?

This may occur if the URL prefix conflicts with existing content or if rewrite rules are not flushed. Visit Settings > Permalinks and click Save to refresh rewrite rules. Ensure the prefix (e.g., real-estate) is unique.

Is the plugin accessible?

The plugin’s shortcodes generate HTML with basic accessibility support. The PeakIDX site pages are also tested periodically based on WCAG 2.1 accessibility guidelines. Ensure your theme and any custom styles follow WCAG guidelines for full accessibility. Test your site with accessibility tools like WAVE to ensure compliance.

Does this plugin support WordPress Multisite?

No, this plugin does not officially support WordPress Multisite. It has not been tested in a multisite environment, and there may be conflicts or unexpected behavior. We recommend using it only on standard, single-site WordPress installations.

Can I see a live demo?

Yes! Visit https://peakidx.com/live-demo/ to see PeakIDX in action.

Where can I find documentation?

Comprehensive documentation, including API references and integration guides, is available at https://docs.peakidx.com/.

How can I get support?

For support inquiries, visit https://peakidx.com/support/ or contact us at https://peakidx.com/contact-us/. You can also call us at (386) 255-5556.

What features does PeakIDX offer?

PeakIDX offers a comprehensive suite of features for real estate professionals. Visit our Tour page to explore all features.
